cds.title: Northern Kentucky University Common Data Set 2023-2024 (PDF)

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: Fall 2023 entering class (from the Common Data Set). NKU's 2024-2025 Common Data Set PDF on its site is an unfilled template and no 2025-2026 Common Data Set is posted, so 2023-2024 is the latest usable one. International first-year applicants 1,625, admitted 299, enrolled 12 (from the residency table); a further 6 applicants of unknown residency (3 admitted) are not in the in-state/out-of-state/international columns. No waitlist.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set 2023-2024: ACT/SAT required for any student under 21 with a high school GPA below 2.75 seeking a degree program; students with 2.75+ applying to select programs may be required to submit scores.

cost.notes: In the 2023-2024 Common Data Set, 298 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $15,100 (total $4,499,790); the Common Data Set does not say whether it was need- or non-need-based. The tuition entries in the Common Data Set were not readable; tuition and fees come from NKU's international costs page
